- Kubernetes, Temporal, Terraform, Helm, Go: Kubernetes is in skills and a cert ("Learning Kubernetes"), Go only from SAP (CLI tool). No Temporal or Terraform on resume.

## JD (role-relevant parts)

Globex is building the context layer for enterprise AI. The Agent & App Platform team builds the foundations for teams, partners and customers to build, run, distribute, observe and govern apps and agents at scale. The role sets technical direction for the agent registry and gateway platform.

**Areas:** Agent Registry & Gateways (registering, discovering, authenticating, governing, routing agents, tools and MCP servers). Agent Platform (identity, context, secure execution, sessions, checkpointing, observability). App Runtime (Kubernetes and Temporal). Distribution & Automation (packaging, deployment, marketplace, workflows, triggers, templates).

**What you'll do:**
- Design and build platform services for agents, tools and MCP servers: registries, gateways, authn/authz, routing, policy enforcement, audit logging, tracing.
- Build primitives for agent execution and lifecycle: templates, marketplace, secure sandboxing, tenant-aware context, durable sessions, checkpointing, observability.
- Evolve workflow and runtime infra on Temporal, Kubernetes and cloud-native tech: reliability, scalability, performance, cost.
- Design and operate multi-tenant distributed systems at scale: isolation, failure recovery, capacity, noisy neighbours.
- Partner with Product and Engineering on architecture, RFCs and technical standards.
- Mentor engineers, run design reviews, raise the technical bar.

**Looking for:**
- 14+ years in platform engineering, infrastructure or backend systems, ideally SaaS.
- Platform services, API gateways, service registries, control planes or similar.
- Distributed systems and multi-tenant architecture: event-driven systems, service communication, orchestration, retries, idempotency, failure recovery.
- Strong Kubernetes, containers, AWS and/or GCP.
- Systems with clear reliability, latency, capacity and cost requirements, both 0 to 1 and mature.
- Autonomy on ambiguous cross-functional problems; clear communication of trade-offs.

**Plus:** MCP, A2A, agent frameworks/runtimes, LLM gateways, agent observability. Marketplaces, plugin or extension platforms, developer platforms, workflow systems. Identity and authz for non-human actors, sandboxing, context propagation. Temporal, Terraform, Helm, GitOps, CI/CD, container registries. Enterprise SLOs, distributed tracing, cost attribution.

**Stack:** Go, Python, AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Karpenter, Temporal, MCP, Terraform, Helm, Prometheus, Grafana, GitOps.

**Culture:** AI-native engineering org (Claude, Cursor), remote-first, async.
